command_line:
set -eu
mkdir work
cd work
tar -xzf "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78896691/inputs/dataset_5c59d779-cfb3-44af-8ee9-83096ed17b0c.dat"
: > plink.log
run_plink() {
  echo "COMMAND: plink2 $*" >> plink.log
  if plink2 "$@" >> plink.log 2>&1; then
    echo "STATUS: ok" >> plink.log
  else
    echo "STATUS: failed" >> plink.log
  fi
}
run_plink --pfile match.genotypes.1.1 --chr 9 --from-bp 133000000 --to-bp 134000000 --export A --out abo_1
run_plink --pfile match.genotypes.1.3 --chr 9 --from-bp 133000000 --to-bp 134000000 --export A --out abo_3
run_plink --pfile match.genotypes.1.1 --chr X --export A --out chrX_1
run_plink --pfile match.genotypes.1.1 --chr Y --export A --out chrY_1
run_plink --pfile match.genotypes.1.1 --check-sex --out sexcheck_1
run_plink --pfile match.genotypes.1.1 --freq counts --out freq_1
tar -czf ../extracts.tar.gz plink.log *.raw *.sscore *.sexcheck *.afreq match.genotypes.1.1.psam match.genotypes.1.2.csv match.genotypes.1.1.pvar 2>/dev/null || tar -czf ../extracts.tar.gz plink.log
cd ..
